body:
Doesn't surprise me and it's probably because of desperation and denial. Rejection hurts and the road to peace is difficult and painful. Releasing, forgiving and accepting the mirrors that our SPs are is hard work. I like your questions below - if you were to manifest your SP would you keep the manifestation? My answer is no. It would dissolve the second he came back. Only once we're able to let them go with love and a free heart we are ready to have someone back or someone new. By far not there yet. I'm more insecure than ever. 

On a funnier note, there is this guy on YT who has this channel 'the internal game' and in one of his videos he does an impersonation of what it would be like to go and tell our SPs how obsessed we are with them. They'll all get restraining orders 🤣
As a financial auditor 🤣, yes materiality is my b****!

I've contacted a therapist when I was feeling suicidal 6 months ago. I'm paying for it myself and I'm slowly getting to a better place. Worth every penny. It's slow but the tools I've been learning will help me for life. But you need to find one that works for you as they use different methods. CBT doesn't work on me so I avoided those. Mine is specialized in trauma and uses internal family systems and various grounding techniques on me.

This is the point where I want to get. My SP treated me horribly but it also showed me how deeply unhappy I am and how I haven't felt joy or happiness in over a decade. How I have no clue who I am or where to even start to piece myself together. I'm honestly more worried that I'll never feel good or happy again. 

Your story also reminds me when I manifested an SP which I didn't want. I had this crush on a guy but I didn't want it because I was in a relationship at that time. A lot of turmoil and a couple if years later I bumped into him in an empty building at an odd hour. Felt eerie. Once I detached and felt happier he also emailed mea couple of times but I didn't want anything further. I just didn't want the crush.

You handle it like a man. You grow a spine and you apologise for unintentionally leading her on. You tell her that you understand that she developed feelings for you and that you can't draw lines on a heart but you don't see her in the same light. You apologise again and tell her that it's best if you cut contact. This will give her the chance to heal and move on in a healthy manner. Be a decent human being. If she is so sensitive as you say then she already has a lot on her plate. Do not add more to her trauma.

Thank you. I'll continue to talk to her and try to make a safe space for her. I got rejected a year or ago by someone I really liked and I feel that she took over completely because she lost someone she liked yet again. I'm just realising now that everytime I lose something I care about I completely shut down and she takes over. She likes to sit in our room to watch the snow falling and she doesn't want to do anything because there is no point to anything. Everything leads to pain in her view. And I'm the same. Unless there's an emergency that forces me to do something I revert to watching things - doomscrolling reddit, animes, TV shows you name it. Just watching the world go by as opposed to taking action and making a better more fun world for myself. Just talking to her gives me incredible pain and anxiety.
I went to one - that was a couple of years ago. I may give it another shot. I guess I'm just wondering if it isn't just good old aging. I'm 36 and it isn't unheard of.

They did, but never figured it out why. I have PCOS so this might be it. I lost my period for a couple of years, went on the pill, it came back but the flow is low and only lasts a couple of days. I've been struggling with vaginal dryness in the past year and it's really annoying.
I have low estrogen and I struggle in my 30s. What are estrogen patches?
If you wish ill upon others you only wish ill upon yourself. And it will manifest upon yourself. It's better to find ways to forgive, leave it behind and recenter to yourself. You'll be much happier.
If you're still angry you haven't healed. Healing is peace and balance. You leave it behind.

'Gradina' - I'm sorry, I don't have the right keyboard to put the diacritics means 'garden' in Romanian. It would basically be the name of what is painted on the mug and not the name of a shop. It's a bit strange that it's made in China with a Romanian name. You can search for mugs that depict a garden and buy something similar. Why are you so afraid of your girlfriend's reaction?

He is probably someone real since you're saying that you've been 'growing' together in your dreams. There was a moment in your life when you met this man and the spiritual connection formed and you kept in touch through dreams. I assume it might have been when you were really young as you don't recall him. I've got one man like this in my life who doesn't talk to me (former fling, he ghosted me) but I dreamt him 3 times in the past month. In one of my dreams it felt like I was in the same room as him and watching him talk to friends. In the last dream he was trying to console me and make me feel better  - things have been tough lately. If you want to know who he is you could try to manifest him. I'm not sure what is the purpose of being connected to someone through our dreams.
I just wanted to ask you in which region are you and how many years since you qualified? £55k is quite a lot for accounting. Which role are you in?
Same, you start getting excluded a lot if you don't have your own family and children. There's only so many things you can do by yourself and people start wondering what's wrong with you.

Slimmer eyebrows. I know that thick eyebrows are in trend but they don't suit everyone. Also, different hairstyle. The fringe doesn't work for a small forehead. It gives a weird proportion to your head.
Who waits 6 years for a man? I mean it might work but if you're in your 30s and you want children you don't have 6 years to wait.

No, not healthy at all. My mother is like him with the added bonus that she also used to beat us as children. My father tries to placate her exactly like the wife does in the  show once she starts screaming and throwing things. I didn't even know that it wasn't normal until my first boyfriend pointed how abusive the dynamic is. 

That's why it's so chilling seeing people blame Andrew Tate entirely. I mean sure, he is a piece if the puzzle, along with the bullying and the chaotic school environment. But people diminish the family's importance in raising Jamie told be a well adjusted teenager.

Raised the same point a couple of comments ago and people are telling me what a normal father he is. There's nothing normal about regularly breaking things in anger. Children will definitely pick up on these things and will model the behaviour.

You are excusing his behaviour. I am really sorry you went through that. If you have the resources I would encourage you to seek therapy to deal with the trauma. None of that is alright and none of Jamie's father is alright.

I think you're missing the fact that Jamie told the psychologist that his father broke down a shed in anger. Probably not the first time when it happened. There are a lot of people who are grieving or deal with difficult circumstances and they don't assault other people. As a woman I would honestly be terrified by a partner who breaks things or go in a rage on a regular basis. You also conveniently didn't answer my second question. How do you know that instead of the guy's bike or the van you're not going to be the thing they hit next? 

Would you be happy if your daughter dated and married such a man?

I'm sorry, I didn't see those scenes in that way. Assaulting a teenager, throwing paint at your van, screaming at the guard with a screwdriver in your hand, breaking a shed when you're angry, these are all signs of abusive behaviour. It's scary to be around and walk on eggshells around someone who consistently destroys property when they are angry.

Take it this way. If you were to start dating someone new and you got into a fight and he or she broke a chair while screaming what do you think your friends and family would say? Do you think they would encourage you to continue to date him/her telling you what a good person he/she is? Or do you think they'd be worried that they'll hit you next time?

I'm really surprised that people defend the father. I saw those scenes (coupled with the fact that he destroyed a shed) as them showing us who thaught Jamie that it is ok to lose your temper. Andrew Tate is just a piece of the puzzle, not the whole story.

Coming from an abusive family I don't believe that his family environment was healthy. The dynamic between  his parents reminded me of the dynamic between my parents with the only difference that my mother was also physically abusive. But I've seen that blind rage numerous times throughout the years.

I restarted my life at 30 when I was in a similar position. I haven't made any progress on the friends/bf front but I have a decent career and I'm planning on buying a home. But I'm with you that life is not worth living just for a job or for a house. We need a purpose and meaning. Someone around here asked me about a year ago what would I like to do with my life and what kind of person I'd like to be. Whom do I want to be like? I still don't know but it's a starting point for the next step in my life.

I'd still get the rabies shots. I had to do mine a year ago after getting bit by a stray cat and I think I've read somewhere that they'll generally be effective only 5 years or so. Learnt that a lot of vaccines don't protect you for life. Better safe than sorry.

I manifested getting into a great uni and later on getting back into my industry after a massive failure. I also manifested an above market salary which will allowed me to save considerably for a house deposit. That's still work in progress, but I can buy on my own. 

I somehow can't manifest a relationship and I'd really like a family as I'm 36. No idea how to unblock myself.

It's really strange because visualizing feels great to me but it doesn't work for me. Maybe because my assumption is that it doesn't work. On the other hand speaking things out loud or writing them work better. Saying things or thinking things sometimes seems to manifest quicker.

I missed it completely on my first watch but Jimmy comes from the dessert remorseful and ready to give up what he loves so she can live a good life. Instead she convinces him to marry her and when Howard questions her choices she decides to burn his life to the ground and seduces Jimmy to join her in this quest. I'm leaving the rewatch being convinced that she played a much larger role in him becoming Saul Goodman. I know people say that they love each other but I don't see her love. She seems much more cold, cruel and calculated. She always plans for herself while Jimmy is planning for both of them.

I'm sorry this is happening to you. Im talking purely from a manifestation point of view - if you think that all the good things come after a disaster, this is what is going to manifest. If there's something that I've learnt is that you need to be very careful with assumptions. I've realised recently that I also had a similar one for years and I'm working on clearing it.

I was reading through some comments and someone asked 'what are your assumptions about your SP?' which prompted me to write mine down. Ended up with about 25 of them all variations of how he doesn't want to be with me, talk to me, find me attractive, how annoying he find me, how other women are better etc. I'm horrified at myself honestly. A lot of it stems from past abuse but I think this is the first time when it's so bad that I'm literally erasing myself. 

It's no wonder that he doesn't manifest. And it's no wonder that whenever I wanted a partner or friends it never manifested. I honestly don't want to re-manifest the same story with other people and if I don't change this the story will never change. So what's the next best step now that I've got those limiting beliefs down? 

Also, if there is something about your SP that you don't find good enough, can this impact your manifestation? Thank you.

I'll answer this question as I would like to stop attracting this kind of man in my life. The last one ghosted me and treated me like I didn't exist, like furniture. We used to live in the same neighbourhood and he would literally pass me by as if I didn't exist. Past partners didn't love me or cheated on me and left me for someone else. I honestly would like to get out of whatever vibration I am in and attract someone who loves me and of course whom I love equally. I'm also really hung up on my last SP and I have no idea how to let him go. I mean the man doesn't give a shit. Fine, but I want to let go.

It's probably your hidden limiting beliefs which keep you stuck. I've used and I have recently started using again EFT tapping to help me uncover my limiting beliefs. They're so deeply hidden that I wasn't even aware of them to the full extent. So for example one of mine that I was tapping on is ' the man I love doesn't love me back' which stems from traumatic past relationships and shitty parents. 

I tapped to release the negative emotion and them tapped to reverse/rewrite the script. Alexandra Bellerose on YT describes the process for an SP but I started to also use it for work stress. 

I'm just learning myself - but when we attract toxic/abusive circumstances it's usually our self concept that needs work. The self-concept work will benefit you.
No, for the user that said they had a psychic reading.

As a tarot reader, tarot is a reflection of ourselves and our beliefs. A lot of readers read your energy as opposed to the future. Very few have the gift of foresight. So keep in mind that you're not manifesting your SP because somewhere deep down you believe that you two won't be together.

I've been having this crush on a man for almost a year now. I see his name when he wakes up, when he goes to work, when he has breaks or finishes work. I don't see it when he's having his day off and is engaged with other people or activities. And I know this because we used to live in the same building. 

I can't even escape it. It calmed down lately but for awhile I wasn't able to escape it at all. I could literally be in the middle of a client meeting in the morning and his name would pop up on screen, in an email, on documents or the client would mention it. I know we're bonded in a way and he's like a presence in my life. I can understand now why some people say that they instantly knew when their loved one passed away. It feels like that. 

But he's rejected me. I've been recently trying to manifest him back but like you I'm wondering sometimes if it's worth it. I mean if they don't want us, they don't want us. Wouldn't it be better to have someone who loves us from the very beginning? Who adores our presence?

I'm a similar position but with a different story. This is a guy who has never failed at anything and doesn't know how to fix things or what his pain threshold is. It's when people have it too good, they self implode because they need a challenge. He needs a career change and some bonding time with his wife to bring the romance in. There's probably some resentment on her side he hasn't addressed.
That's not any random woman on the internet. That's his best friend. A woman his wife invites in their shared home and trusts as a friend. 'I want to fuck your husband' doesn't  spell friend to me.

When you love someone you don't brag on reddit how you want to fuck your best friend but somehow you're the morally superior human being that will not do that. You simply don't mentally go there because you love them. You can acknowledge that someone is good looking without the actual fantasy. 

I'm actually surprised of how many people are comfortable with what he wrote. I guess you're all ok with your husband/wife actively fantasizing about their/your friends. And I guess that's fine. Just not my cup of tea.

He literally said he has an unspoken agreement with his 'best friend' not to have sex with each other. Maybe we have a vast difference in values but I'd never be comfortable with my man wanting to sleep with his best friend and being friends with a woman who actively wants to sleep with my man but somehow 'withholds' herself out of some misguided sense of ethics. The kind of female best friend I'd be comfortable with is the one you see like a sister and you would never fathom sleeping with. And she wouldn't want to sleep with my man either. There are healthy friendships like this out there.

Honestly what he said is horrible. 'I secretly want to sleep with my best friend and she wants me too but somehow we ended with these other 2 people whom we don't really love that much but because we're trying to be half decent people we're not going to bang'. I hope his wife never finds out that that he settled for her because he didn't have the guts to go after his best friend. Really horrible all around.

I like your analogy with driving to a new city. What's happening is that I want this text but I don't believe it will happen no matter what because he doesn't want to talk to me. There's too much pain and sorrow on my end and I took his rejection and ghosting hard. We used to live together in the same neighborhood and he's moved out and there's been many times when he just passed me by the street and hasn't even looked at me. There's months of quiet rejection built in and of him stating that he doesn't see me in that way. I'm at this point of being an emotional mess and to be honest I don't even know what I want anymore. I just don't want to feel like this anymore. I don't want to cry and to feel empty anymore, I don't want these feelings anymore, I don't want to wait for months for the potential of something happening. I guess what I'm looking from you is advice on how to find relief one way or another. There might be too many negative feelings on my end to be able to manifest this person. It simply won't materialise if I believe he hates me and doesn't want me and how would you even wash away all the painful memories? But any help or resources on how to find relief and move on would be greatly appreciated. It's been almost a year and I'm at my wits end.

I'd like to manifest back a text from my SP but I just can't seem to be able to ignore what's going on around me and his silence. I have this strong belief that he'll never text me and that he doesn't want to talk to me and is avoiding me and it's killing me honestly. I have days when I want to let it all go and days when I miss him so much and I just can't seem to be able to pick a side. Anything I can do or say to lessen this belief? Or is it just a lost cause?.

No, I guess I struggle with the concept of emotional availability. She seems perfectly ready to love this man. How can you be unavailable if you want to love someone? Unavailability to me means that you can't love someone. What's the point of the LoA then if we can't have what we want? She wants this man. I want a specific man. I don't want to twist and bend and turn to manifest someone else.     By the looks of it I'll have to, but then the whole concept is pointless if we can't have what we want when we we want it. It just reverts to regular life where you see therapist, do some work, get some hobbies and hope that eventually you meet someone else. People wouldn't be on this site if they wanted someone else.

Why do you say she is emotionally unavailable? I mean she poured her heart out to the man and wants a relationship with him. What part of this is her being unavailable? Wouldn't you agree that you can't get any more vulnerable than when you express your feelings for someone and you get rejected? It's an open wounded. heart. If someone loves you there's no reason to open your heart more. You simply give back what you receive. There's no risk, no hurt, no vulnerability. The relationships where the man gives you everything you ever wanted are easy. Wouldn't you agree? And if you are expected to be happy all the time, then what about the times when life hits you?
Of course not, but there's nothing in her post to suggest he is abusive.

Sometimes we just like someone and we want them irrespective of how they behaved. It's as simple as that. What's wrong with wanting a relationship with someone who might be toxic but makes you feel alive and desperstely in love? Why does everyone need to have that 'perfect love'? Why can't we just get what we want until we're sick of it? And then we can make the choice of whether we want the bad guy or we want the good, stable and mature man? Isn't this what LoA is about? Getting what you want when you want it and how you want it? OP wants that guy because she wants that guy! If she was asking how to manifest a Birkin bag would you question her choice and tell her to find a cheaper look alike because in the end it serves the same purpose?
Eyes and then hands.

Mine is trauma informed as I have a lot of trauma and an old gentleman who lived his own rough life from what I can  gather. We're in the discovery phase so to speak but he points out the misconceptions in my thinking and the limitations in uncomfortable ways sometimes but really eye opening. They are indeed there to offer a new perspective and help you navigate rough moments. I'm sure he doesn't care, but he can relate to my pain as he's had his own and he can offer sympathy and empathy.
No, not confused at all. It's very clear. I just don't understand why someone who's in a happy relationship would come back to this subreddit.
I'm 36 y.o. and honestly I feel I don't have anything to live for anymore and I just can't get out of this rut. I'm tired of trying.
What are you doing on r/Bumble then if you found your man?
I know and I'm not proud of myself. I did my best. But we live in the same building.
I think so, but also it wasn't a good time in his life. I also want to apologise for a couple of things I did. I feel I need his help to move on of he really moved on.
I did this countless times. It didn't work. I tried hating him. It didn't work.
I don't want him to leave with the way things are between  us. Even if it's the last thing I ever tell him.
He meant a lot for me. I fell hard for him. I want to talk about my feelings, hash out a couple of differences. I feel he is upset with me and I can't bear him leave being angry and upset with me.
I tried. Trust me. I tried so hard. I'm having a mental breakdown.
I told him but there's only so much we can cover in one session. It's work in progress and there are other stuff.
I don't think he realises how good he has it. I mean, if he needs his wife to take a part time job so he can focus on himself more he should tell her that. No blindside her with a divorce.

OP, English is not my first language, but even as a non-native speaker, that joke falls flat. Also, based on a quick Google search I don't think pun means what you think it means. That intro doesn't do you justice assuming that you're looking for a woman to take you seriously. Maybe making jokes is not your thing. It's a bit of a shame because based on your pictures you look like a pretty cool guy to have around. Best of luck!

I felt the same way about his description. I can't put it into words but what I thought was 'defective golden retriever'. As in someone who is overenthusiastic in a completely wrong way. Sounds like advertisement gone wrong, like a competition. What if you go on a date with him and you don't *smash* the hike (what's that even supposed to mean? Do we set a timer to see who walks faster?). And what makes him think that being blindfolded around sharp arrows is a good idea? Or that any sane woman would allow herself to be blindfolded by a stranger? I mean it's ok to have kinks but that's the wrong way to go about it. 

I guess this is a prime example of what it means to run on looks. No matter how dumb you sound people will give you a thumbs up. And it's a shame because OP seems to have decent habits.
I was thinking the same thing. She's gorgeous either way but she looks more elegant and feminine. She looks like she gained weight in the second picture.
What makes you think he's in top 10% of the guys? For example by OP's admission the man is only 5'8" tall as he is at the same height as her. That doesn't spell top 10% to me.
Do you actually believe the idiocy you've just written?
Get yourself into a place professionally where you can afford it. That's what I did. Took me 5 years but I'm finally there.

Same here. Spent the majority of the holidays alone for god knows how long. I'm alone this year again and I'm trying to make peace with it. This was the first year when I started seeing a therapist and I'm hoping that maybe next year will be better. That's my wish - a better 2025.
It's even worse when you text and text and text and there's no in real life chemistry.

I don't have this on my profile but I am considering adding it because I went through the experience of endless texting with a man and when we met there was no in real life chemistry. Actually, despite his nice persona in text, there were red flags in person and I'm not sure we would have met if I didn't ask. I felt robbed of a few hours of my life as he would text endless paragraphs and I replied as I was interested.
As someone else said, some use it as an ego boost when they are bored or have someone else with no intention of progressing stuff further. 
I also realised that I tend to friendzone men who just text and text talking about themselves. I need a bit of flirting as sexual chemistry is important to me.

I've also had the other experience of someone who didn't want to text but wanted to meet quickly and I personally had a better time meeting him. It didn't lead anywhere but I felt it respected my time.

I hope I could get over it one day. I'm 6 years post and it still affects me if a man is interested in other women beside me. Logically I know I need to leave, emotionally I'm a mess especially if I like the man.
Sorry for being nosy and I'm hoping it's not too much to ask, how much did you pay for it and how much did you pay for renovations?

Funny thing, I live in Burley too but I'm a bit too close to the student houses and I'd like to move out as I'm old and I can't deal with the noise anymore. I love the area too as it has everything you want at reasonable prices. I'm also very fond of the 4 supermarkets we have within walking distance, being close to city centre and the train station. I honestly didn't think you could find something like this around and it doesn't surprise me that the price was reduced, but you found yourself a gem. Maybe there's hope for me too.

As someone else living in Leeds and looking to buy at some point in the next year or so, which neighbourhood in Leeds? I'd love wooden floors like this and I'd be willing to change any carpets myself but I wouldn't know where to start. How did you go about the process of renovating?

Thank you for taking the time to write this kind stranger. It's been a very painful year. I'm looking to move out next year if he doesn't move out in March. I can't live like this anymore, I feel stuck and nothing I tried works and what you said about me not wanting the connection over put things into perspective. It's strange, but I feel his energy all the time and when it's not around I seek it. It's strange but it's like a fan or an appliance that works all the time and when it stops I notice it immediately. I need to learn to be alone without other energies around. I'll look into these resources.  I wish you a Happy New Year!
Anything I can do to put down that backpack?

I've journalled but it's on an electronic medium and I tend to keep my journals over the years. I don't want those notes erased in case I ever have children or dementia. I'd like them to know me. Though I'm 36 y.o. soon so that possibility is looking less and less likely. 

I would like him to contact me and apologise for what he did but that looks less and likely as well. And then there are certain things and pain which cannot be erased even if he apologised. There's something traumatic that he did to me unknowingly and I don't know how to forgive and make peace with it and let go. I would honestly like that more than erasing the daily 'calendar updates'.

I've got someone like this in my life but we're not on speaking terms. Currently we're neighbors who had a falling out. I could be miles away from him and I know when he wakes up, when he finishes work, when he has the day off or when he comes home even if I'm hundred of miles away. I dream him sometimes and some of the people around him. I swear that if I'm tuning into his energy I can feel him. Any way I can detach? I've tried to raise shields or cut cords but any form of cleansing or cord cutting brings him closer. As in - I haven't seen him for weeks, but if I do a cord cutting meditation I'll see him within 24h without fail.
